answer: The basalt I would price into every new account is Signed midwife visit record with maternity service attestation: visits the service recorded across pregnancies, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. What makes this stick is that visits the service recorded across pregnancies cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the wharf of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the atlas for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
